reuse.why: All six month-wide actions reuse getFillableCategories and existing tag and mutation helpers, but setLastMonthSpending reimplements spending totals instead of reading existing sum-amount sheet cells through getSheetValue.

duplication.why: The shared selector removes repeated category queries, but the new action duplicates transaction aggregation from base.ts and repeats the income eligibility guard.

placement.why: Category selection and action registration fit the existing budget modules, although transaction aggregation already belongs to the sheet computation in base.ts.

scope.why: The edits address the four requested changes and their release notes without unrelated modifications.

maintainability.why: Centralized exclusions simplify future changes, but independently maintained spending queries and distributed income eligibility checks leave multiple definitions to keep aligned.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts:setLastMonthSpending directly aggregates transactions instead of using getSheetValue for the sum-amount cells defined in budget/base.ts and consumed by getCategoryAverage.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending reshapes base.ts:getSumAmountsByMonth into a single-month grouped query and category-keyed map while retaining the same transaction summation and account filtering.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and one conditional SQL branch; all six month-wide actions continue through that selector.
